name: check
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check && bun test research/protocols/ic3syn/mldr.test.ts

name: capture
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; if timeout 320s env GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=1 DUMP_DIR=/tmp/pstar-dump DUMP_MIN=0 DUMP_N=100000 bun --preload ./research/query/dump.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only mldr --skip broken; then code=0; else code=$?; fi; echo CAPTURE_EXIT=$code; if test -f /tmp/pstar-dump/queries.jsonl; then wc -l /tmp/pstar-dump/queries.jsonl; fi
